fact: The document sets out Mauritania's ten-year national statistical development strategy SNDDS 2021-2030 with an action plan for 2021-2025; it gives no adoption date, so the published date is used.
The document contains a strategic evaluation and operational review of the previous SNDS 2016-2020, with results rated by axis; it gives no completion date, so the published date is used.
PARIS21's January 2026 NSDS status table lists the strategy as implementing (adopted): SNDDS 2021-2023.
